_note: Elemental reactions shown on each character's page, the main one first. Hand-written from community consensus and the site owner's picks (not game data), keyed by roster key. Reaction names and their elements are listed in REACTION_ELEMENTS in src/lib/genshin/characterDetails.ts. Generalist and Swirl support are tags in the same list: Generalist for characters who don't rely on their own element, Swirl support for Anemo characters who are there to Swirl. Stellar Glimmer is a state, not a reaction, so it isn't listed. Characters in elementOnly are best with their own element alone and show a single chip instead. An empty or missing list hides the Reactions row.
